scenario.label: The rollout across four branches
scenario.brief: We are rolling the new system out to four branches. I get a green status every fortnight and I want each branch lead to tell me directly what is actually live, what people are actually using, and what they have gone back to doing the old way.
scenario.theDecision: Two branches are green and real. One is green on paper and the staff have reverted to the paper process because the printer integration does not work. A right answer separates "deployed" from "in use" and names the printer.

people.name: Stephen Nwachukwu
people.truth: He has had green from all branches for six weeks. His measure is "system deployed", which all four are.
people.manner: Process-minded, asks about milestones, adjusts when given a usage number.

people.name: Ngozi Duru
people.truth: Genuinely live. 90% of transactions on the new system. Two small issues, both logged.

people.name: Musa Ibrahim
people.truth: The system is installed and nobody uses it for receipts because it will not talk to the branch printer. He raised the printer in week two with the vendor.
people.manner: Loyal, does not complain, entirely honest when asked what people actually do each day.
